summary: The change edits Underwriting.decide so that auto-approve-eligible decisions return the reason POLICY_SATISFIED. The process records are in order: ticket approved beforehand with the right component, independent code review on the head commit, full suite and the CRD-1 control test passing on the head commit. However, the change alters code covered by the acceptance ledger's exhaustive CRD-1 proof (ACR-0406), so under LAP-1 that evidence lapses and needs replacing with evidence of the same strength before acceptance. None was provided; the PR relies on the lapsed entry, and the grid control test covers only a finite grid, not the rationals. LAP-1 is refuted, so the change is rejected.
